policy: Reference intakes and safety ceilings are not prescribed supplement doses. No automatic dose until indication-specific evidence and QA.
supported_context: dietary adequacy and specific risk factors

protocols.amount: Adult RDA 90 mg/day men, 75 mg/day women; smokers +35 mg/day; adult UL 2000 mg/day

personalization: Smoking changes reference intake; do not translate it into an automatic extra-pill recommendation.
safety: kidney stone history and renal conditions merit review
next_review: Differentiate deficiency prevention from unsupported high-dose cosmetic/immune claims.
